title: Junta Airstrike Kills Two Elderly Women in Nyaung-U Township
detail: A Myanmar military airstrike hit Nyaung-U Township, Mandalay Region (near Bagan), on September 23, 2026, killing two elderly women and damaging at least 10 houses. The strike was reported alongside two other same-day airstrikes in Indaw and Ponnagyun townships as part of a broader wave of junta air attacks.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Nyaung-U airstrike.

title: Junta Airstrike Kills Three Civilians, Destroys Fuel Tankers in Indaw Township
detail: A junta airstrike on Indaw Township, Sagaing Region, killed three civilians and destroyed fuel tankers on September 23, 2026. Reported the same day as separate airstrikes in Nyaung-U and Ponnagyun townships.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Indaw Township airstrike.

title: Junta Jet Drops ~20 Bombs on Fak Kya Village, Ponnagyun Township, Killing Two
detail: A Myanmar military jet dropped approximately 20 bombs on Fak Kya Village, Ponnagyun Township, Rakhine State, on September 23, 2026, killing two civilians. Part of the same day's wave of junta airstrikes reported in Nyaung-U and Indaw townships.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Fak Kya Village airstrike in Ponnagyun Township.

title: Junta Column Burns 140+ Homes and Monastery in Eastern Letpadan Township
detail: A roughly 400-troop junta column burned more than 140 homes and a monastery across Eastern Letpadan Township, Bago Region, reported September 23, 2026 — 40 homes in Taungtan Myaing Village, 20 in the Yoma area, and 82 belonging to displaced persons. A separate drone strike in the same area killed 2 civilians and injured 2 more.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Letpadan Township village-burning campaign and drone strike.

title: Army Artillery Shell Kills Seven-Year-Old in Da Kyaung Village, Myingyan Township
detail: A shell fired from a nearby army battalion struck Da Kyaung Village, Myingyan Township, Mandalay Region, on September 23, 2026, killing a seven-year-old child and injuring a Grade 7 and a Grade 2 student. No active fighting was reported in the area at the time.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the fatal artillery strike in Da Kyaung Village.
